name: fridge-stock
description: Fridge stock tracking for the Lighthouse group, Swakopmund

scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
